title: The Power of Women
subtitle: Dr. Meriem & Dr. Sofia are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 👩‍⚕️💪

Dr. Meriem is a young passionate dentist. She has just learned that she is pregnant. Immense joy, but also anxiety: 'How am I going to manage my practice during my leave? And my patients? And my return?'

Dr. Sofia, an experienced dentist and mother, takes her under her wing. 'Meriem, you are not alone. 75% of practitioners fear the impact of motherhood on their career. But with preparation and support, anything is possible.'

Between choosing a replacement, administrative procedures, managing fatigue, breastfeeding, and returning to work, the path is full of obstacles.

A poorly prepared leave, a rushed return, and stress sets in. Good anticipation, a support network, and motherhood becomes a strength.

The future of women dentists, their fulfillment, and their success rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Meriem is pregnant and anxious. Dr. Sofia, her mentor, helps her prepare her maternity leave: rights, replacement, administrative procedures, patient preparation.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Meriem and Dr. Sofia deepen the management of the return: gradual return, work-life balance, breastfeeding, patient loyalty, stress management.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Meriem and Dr. Sofia master the aspects of maternity leave: rights, replacement, administrative aspects, preparation. Meriem is ready to leave serenely.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Meriem and Dr. Sofia face the challenges of returning: return, balance, practice management, equilibrium. The practice is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Meriem and Dr. Sofia become references for women dentists. They train the new generation on the importance of preparation and support.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Dr. Meriem and Dr. Sofia pass on their wisdom. The power of women is an asset to the profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Meriem understood that she is not alone and that everything can be prepared.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Meriem and Sofia have mastered the aspects of return. Meriem is ready.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of maternity leave is acquired. Meriem is serene.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Managing the return is mastered. Meriem takes on all challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Women's strategy has become a philosophy. Meriem and Sofia train the next generation.
chapterEndings.expert2: Meriem and Sofia have accomplished their mission. The power of women is an asset to the profession.
